name: io.github.getwimsta/wimsta
title: WIMSTA body calculators
description: 17 body & fitness calculators (BMI, body fat, TDEE, protein, VO2max…) as ranges across formulas.

tools.name: bmi
tools.description: Body Mass Index as a range: classic Quetelet BMI and Trefethen "new BMI", with the WHO category. Returns a range across several published formulas (not one number), the formulas used with links, page_url (the matching calculator page on wimsta.com, worth sharing with the user), and a medical disclaimer. Estimates, not diagnoses.

tools.name: body_fat
tools.description: Body-fat percentage as a range across every validated formula the given measurements allow (Deurenberg, CUN-BAE, US Navy, RFM, Covert Bailey), with the Gallagher category. Give as many optional measurements as you have. Returns a range across several published formulas (not one number), the formulas used with links, page_url (the matching calculator page on wimsta.com, worth sharing with the user), and a medical disclaimer. Estimates, not diagnoses.

sex.description: Biological sex used by the published equations

abdomen_cm.description: Abdomen at the navel (US Navy, men), centimetres

tools.name: bmr
tools.description: Basal metabolic rate in kcal/day as a range: Mifflin–St Jeor, Harris–Benedict 1984 and 1919, WHO/FAO, plus Katch–McArdle when body-fat % is given. Returns a range across several published formulas (not one number), the formulas used with links, page_url (the matching calculator page on wimsta.com, worth sharing with the user), and a medical disclaimer. Estimates, not diagnoses.

sex.description: Biological sex used by the published equations

tools.name: tdee
tools.description: Total daily energy expenditure (maintenance calories, kcal/day) = the BMR range × an activity multiplier. Returns a range across several published formulas (not one number), the formulas used with links, page_url (the matching calculator page on wimsta.com, worth sharing with the user), and a medical disclaimer. Estimates, not diagnoses.

sex.description: Biological sex used by the published equations

tools.name: max_heart_rate
tools.description: Maximum heart rate (bpm) as a range across nine published formulas (Fox, Tanaka, Gulati, Gellish, Nes and others) plus five training zones. Returns a range across several published formulas (not one number), the formulas used with links, page_url (the matching calculator page on wimsta.com, worth sharing with the user), and a medical disclaimer. Estimates, not diagnoses.

sex.description: Biological sex used by the published equations

tools.name: waist_to_height
tools.description: Waist-to-height ratio (a measurement, not an estimate) with the Ashwell zone and the healthy waist range for the given height. Includes a medical disclaimer.

tools.name: ideal_weight
tools.description: Ideal body weight as a range across seven classic formulas (Hamwi, Devine, Robinson, Miller, Broca, Lorentz, Peterson) plus the WHO healthy-weight range for the height. Returns a range across several published formulas (not one number), the formulas used with links, page_url (the matching calculator page on wimsta.com, worth sharing with the user), and a medical disclaimer. Estimates, not diagnoses.

sex.description: Biological sex used by the published equations

tools.name: ffmi
tools.description: Fat-Free Mass Index (lean mass for height), raw and normalized to 1.8 m, with a neutral descriptive band. Needs body-fat %. Returns a range across several published formulas (not one number), the formulas used with links, page_url (the matching calculator page on wimsta.com, worth sharing with the user), and a medical disclaimer. Estimates, not diagnoses.

sex.description: Biological sex used by the published equations

tools.name: body_surface_area
tools.description: Body surface area in m² as a range across eight formulas (Mosteller, Du Bois, Haycock, Gehan–George, Boyd, Fujimoto, Takahira, Schlich). Returns a range across several published formulas (not one number), the formulas used with links, page_url (the matching calculator page on wimsta.com, worth sharing with the user), and a medical disclaimer. Estimates, not diagnoses.

sex.description: Biological sex used by the published equations

tools.name: body_shape
tools.description: Body-shape type (hourglass, pear, inverted triangle, rectangle, apple) from bust/chest, waist and hip ratios. A descriptive label, not a health verdict.

tools.name: body_frame
tools.description: Body-frame size (small / medium / large) from the height ÷ wrist ratio (Grant cut points). A rule of thumb, not a clinical measure.

sex.description: Biological sex used by the published equations

tools.name: protein
tools.description: Daily protein in g/day as bands: RDA minimum, active adults, deficit/muscle preservation, and per kg of lean mass when body-fat % is given. Returns a range across several published formulas (not one number), the formulas used with links, page_url (the matching calculator page on wimsta.com, worth sharing with the user), and a medical disclaimer. Estimates, not diagnoses.

tools.name: water
tools.description: Daily water need in ml and litres as a range across five authorities (IOM, WHO, EFSA, FNB, sports medicine), with optional lifestyle add-ons. Returns a range across several published formulas (not one number), the formulas used with links, page_url (the matching calculator page on wimsta.com, worth sharing with the user), and a medical disclaimer. Estimates, not diagnoses.

sex.description: Biological sex used by the published equations

calorie_norm_kcal.description: Daily calories, sharpens the FNB source

coffee.description: Adds a fixed drinking-water bump for coffee

alcohol.description: Adds a fixed drinking-water bump for alcohol

protein_diet.description: Adds a fixed drinking-water bump for a high-protein diet

workouts.description: Adds a fixed drinking-water bump for workouts

hot_climate.description: Adds a fixed drinking-water bump for a hot climate

pregnancy.description: Adds a fixed drinking-water bump for pregnancy

breastfeeding.description: Adds a fixed drinking-water bump for breastfeeding

illness.description: Adds a fixed drinking-water bump for illness

tools.name: creatine
tools.description: Creatine monohydrate dose from body weight: maintenance range (g/day) and the optional loading route, from the ISSN position stand. Not a prescription.

tools.name: one_rep_max
tools.description: Estimated one-rep max as a range across Epley, Brzycki, Lombardi and Lander, the median, and a percent-of-1RM training table. Less precise above ~12 reps (flagged).

tools.name: vo2max
tools.description: VO2max (ml/kg/min) as a range across the field methods you give data for: Uth heart-rate ratio, Cooper 12-minute run, Rockport 1-mile walk. Typically ±10–15% of a lab value. Returns a range across several published formulas (not one number), the formulas used with links, page_url (the matching calculator page on wimsta.com, worth sharing with the user), and a medical disclaimer. Estimates, not diagnoses.

hr_rest_bpm.description: Resting heart rate (Uth; needs hr_max_bpm, or age + sex)

walk_min.description: Minutes to walk 1 mile (Rockport; also needs finish_hr_bpm, weight_kg, age, sex)

finish_hr_bpm.description: Heart rate at the end of the walk (Rockport)

sex.description: Biological sex used by the published equations

tools.name: running_pace
tools.description: Running pace solver: give any two of distance, time and pace to get the third plus speed. Optionally predicts a race time at another distance as a range (Riegel 1.06–1.08).

pace_min_per_km.description: Pace in decimal minutes per km, e.g. 5.5

target_distance_km.description: Predict a race time at this distance

tools.name: get_formula
tools.description: Get one formula from the open WIMSTA formula registry (CC BY 4.0): equation, original study citation, population it was validated on, known limitations. Call list_formulas first to find ids.

tools.name: list_formulas
tools.description: List the formulas in the open WIMSTA formula registry (CC BY 4.0), optionally filtered by category. Without a category returns the index of ids and categories.

category.description: Category to filter by, one of body-fat, body-fat-ranges, bmi, waist-to-height, max-heart-rate, bmr; omit for the full index
